name: bento-grid
title: Bento Grid
description: A bento grid of feature cards with uneven spans, each lifting its text and revealing a 'learn more' link when it gets the focus, card by card.

moworks.author: magicui

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: el is the grid; each card has .mw-bg-bg (background), .mw-bg-icon, h3, p and .mw-bg-cta inside. focus: [[t, index, seconds], ...] in s after `at`.
